# Blind Buy Guide
> Don't blind buy it. Sample it first.

## Scents
- [1861 Naxos Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-naxos-edp/): Honey-tobacco with a Sicilian tan. A forum favorite; sample it before paying Xerjoff prices.
- [1861 Renaissance](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-1861-renaissance-edp/): Xerjoff
- [40 Knots](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-40-knots-edp/): Xerjoff
- [724](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/mfk-724-edp/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
- [A La Rose](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/mfk-a-la-rose-edp/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
- [Absolue Pour le Matin Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/absolue-pour-le-matin-edp/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
- [Absolute Aphrodisiac Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/absolute-aphrodisiac-edp/): Initio's headline-grabbing name, with a note list we haven't confirmed yet. Sample it before believing anything the name says.
- [Alexandria II Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/alexandria-ii-edp/): A big-occasion, big-price Xerjoff. The note list reads like a cashmere coat with a cinnamon roll in the pocket. At this price you sample first, full stop.
- [Althair Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/althair-edp/): Parfums de Marly
- [Alto Astral](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-alto-astral-edp/): Byredo
- [Ambre Sultan Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/ambre-sultan-edp/): A Serge Lutens amber that wearers often file under rich and resinous. We haven't confirmed the note list yet, so sample it before you commit 50 ml.
- [Ambrette 9 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/ambrette-9-edp/): Le Labo
- [Amouage Interlude Man Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amouage-interlude-man/): Amouage's famously loud, smoky one. Wearers either call it a masterpiece or a house fire. Find out which camp you're in for the price of a sample.
- [Amyris Femme](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amyris-femme/): Mandarin blossom, pear, jasmine, iris, then a woody-amber finish: the notes promise understated. Sample it, since quiet scents are the hardest ones to judge from a list.
- [Amyris Homme Eau de Toilette](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amyris-homme-edt/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
- [Angels' Share Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/angels-share-edp/): The boozy holiday-party scent. Gorgeous in December, a lot in July. Sample it and wear it on a cold day before committing.
- [Ani Extrait de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/ani-extrait/): Ginger and cardamom into Turkish rose, then vanilla and benzoin, so the list reads warm and a little dessert-adjacent. Sample it before you commit to 50 ml of extrait.
- [Another 13 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/another-13-edp/): The 'is it even on?' scent, in a good way. Some people barely smell it on themselves, so a sample is mandatory before paying Le Labo prices.
- [APOM](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/apom-edp/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
- [Apple Brandy On The Rocks Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/apple-brandy-on-the-rocks-edp/): The notes read like a very good cocktail menu: apple, rum, brandy, vanilla. Sample it, because sweet and boozy is a love-it-or-lose-it proposition.
- [Aqua Universalis Eau de Toilette](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/aqua-universalis-edt/): Clean white T-shirt energy. Pleasant, easy, office-safe; whether it's worth luxury money is a question for your wrist, not the internet.
- [Atomic Rose Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/atomic-rose-edp/): Two kinds of rose, two kinds of jasmine, and olibanum underneath, so it is not shy about being a rose. Sample it and see if you want your florals this extra.
- [Avanguardia](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-avanguardia-extrait/): Xerjoff
- [Aventus Cologne](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-aventus-cologne-edp/): Creed
- [Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/baccarat-rouge-540-edp/): The scent of every elevator since 2017. Instantly recognizable, which is either the point or the problem. A 1 to 2 ml sample tells you which.
- [Bal d'Afrique](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/bal-d-afrique/): A Byredo bestseller. We haven't confirmed its note list yet; sample before paying full-bottle prices.
- [Bal d'Afrique Absolu](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-bal-d-afrique-absolu-extrait/): Byredo
- [Bergamote 22 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/bergamote-22-edp/): A Le Labo citrus. We haven't confirmed its note list yet; at Le Labo prices, sample first.
- [Bibliothèque Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/bibliotheque-edp/): Peach and plum over violet, then leather and vanilla, which is Dark Academia in a bottle if the notes deliver. Sample it before deciding whether it is cozy or just sweet.
- [Bigarade Concentrée Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/frederic-malle-bigarade-concentree-edp/): Frederic Malle
- [Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/bitter-peach-edp/): Peach, rum and cognac over vanilla and tonka, so the notes promise a sticky-sweet dessert. Sample it: this is a statement fragrance with a very short list of people it suits.
- [Black Moonlight](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-black-moonlight-extrait/): Xerjoff
- [Black Phantom Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/black-phantom-edp/): A By Kilian with big fans and big prices. We haven't confirmed its note list yet; sample first.
- [Black Saffron](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-black-saffron-edp/): BYREDO
- [Blanche Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/blanche-edp/): Byredo's crisp, clean, laundered-linen scent. Lovely, subtle, and the kind of thing that smells different on everyone. Sample it.
- [Bois et Fruits Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/bois-et-fruits-edp/): Serge Lutens
- [Bois Marocain Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/bois-marocain-edp/): Peppers and juniper over sandalwood and vetiver, so the notes lean dry and woody. Sample it first; a list this tidy can be either elegant or forgettable.
- [Bois Obscur](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-bois-obscur-extrait/): BYREDO
- [Byerley Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byerley-edp/): A quieter Parfums de Marly than the famous ones. Promising notes, less hype, so test it before you trust it.
- [Carlisle Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/carlisle-edp/): Parfums de Marly
- [Carnal Flower Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/carnal-flower-edp/): Watermelon, tuberose, musk: a three-note list for a scent wearers often call a big white floral. Sample it, because tuberose is the one note people regret blind buying.
- [Casablanca Lily](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-casablanca-lily-extrait/): Byredo
- [Casamorati 1888 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/casamorati-1888-edp/): The library lists only the top notes (coriander, carnation, pepper, saffron), so we can't tell you the drydown yet. That's reason enough to sample before spending a Xerjoff-sized sum.
- [Cedrat Boise](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/cedrat-boise/): A citrus-and-woods scent that wearers often bring up in the same breath as Aventus. Sample it on its own merits before committing to 120 ml.
- [Clair de Musc Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/clair-de-musc-edp/): Serge Lutens
- [Colognisé Extrait de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/colognise-extrait/): Nishane
- [Creed Acqua Fiorentina Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-acqua-fiorentina-edp/): Greengage plum and apple over rose and carnation, then cedar and sandalwood. Sample it and find out whether fruity is a mood for you or a mistake.
- [Creed Aventus](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-aventus/): Not a perfume, a car payment. Wearers describe pineapple and birch over smoky musk, and argue forever about batches. A sample tells you if you're an Aventus person or just watched too much 2016 YouTube.
- [Creed Aventus For Her Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-aventus-for-her-edp/): Creed
- [Creed Bois du Portugal Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-bois-du-portugal-edp/): Creed
- [Creed Carmina Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-carmina-edp/): Creed
- [Creed Fleurissimo Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-fleurissimo-edp/): Creed
- [Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-green-irish-tweed-edp/): The original Creed status scent, before Aventus took the crown. Classic in the best and slightly-dad ways. Sample it, then shop around: bottle prices vary a lot.
- [Creed Love in White Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-love-in-white-edp/): Orange zest, iris and magnolia over vanilla and sandalwood, so the notes read soft and polished. Sample it, since wearers' experience of white florals varies wildly.
- [Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-original-santal-edp/): Coriander and juniper, lavender and ginger, then vanilla and tonka. Sample it before you let a sandalwood in the name do the persuading.
- [Creed Royal Water Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-royal-water-edp/): Creed
- [Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-silver-mountain-water-edp/): Mountain-stream energy. Fresh, metallic, a little old-school. Sample it, because 'fresh' at Creed prices needs to be the right fresh.
- [Creed Spice and Wood Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-spice-and-wood-edp/): Citrus and apple, clove and birch, then oakmoss: a Creed that reads traditional and a bit stern. Sample it, because spice and moss is a very specific appetite.
- [Creed Tabarome Millesime Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-tabarome-edp/): Creed
- [Creed Viking](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-viking/): Creed's peppery, minty one. Interesting on paper; test it on skin before trusting a note list with this much money.
- [Creed Virgin Island Water](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-virgin-island-water/): Creed
- [Cruz Del Sur II](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-cruz-del-sur-ii-edp/): Xerjoff
- [Cuir Sellier](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-cuir-sellier-extrait/): BYREDO
- [Dans Tes Bras Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/dans-tes-bras-edp/): Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle
- [De Los Santos](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-de-los-santos-edp/): BYREDO
- [Decision 42](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amouage-decision-42-extrait/): Amouage
- [Desert Dawn](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-desert-dawn-edp/): BYREDO
- [Do Son Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/do-son-edp/): Diptyque's Do Son, with a note list we haven't confirmed yet. Sample it before assuming anything from the name, or from the candle.
- [Eau des Sens Eau de Toilette](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/eau-des-sens-edt/): Diptyque
- [Eau Lente Eau de Toilette](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/eau-lente-edt/): Diptyque
- [Eau Rose Eau de Toilette](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/eau-rose-edt/): Diptyque
- [Ébène Fumé Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/ebene-fume-edp/): Palo santo, incense, leather, cade oil and ebony: the notes promise a smoldering mood. Sample it, because smoke is flattering on exactly some people.
- [Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/electric-cherry-edp/): Tom Ford
- [Enclave](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amouage-enclave-edp/): Amouage
- [Endymion](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/endymion/): Lavender and bergamot up top, coffee in the heart, leather and incense below: a gentleman's club with a very long list. Sample it first, since a note list this long can go anywhere.
- [Epic Man Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amouage-epic-man-edp/): A long spice-and-resin list that reads like a mood board for a very serious dinner. The notes promise leather and oud, so sample it and see how heavy you like your heavy.
- [Erba Gold](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-erba-gold-edp/): Xerjoff
- [Erba Pura Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/erba-pura-edp/): A fruit-salad-with-vanilla-on-top scent that projects for days. Fun, loud, love-or-hate. Sample it before your coworkers have to.
- [Erolfa Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-erolfa-edp/): Creed's sea-breeze-and-pine one. Bright, outdoorsy, and priced like a yacht. Sample it on a hot day.
- [Fan Your Flames Extrait de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/fan-your-flames-extrait/): Coconut and rum over tobacco and tonka, so the notes promise a beach bar after hours. Sample it before committing 50 ml of extrait to a vacation mood.
- [Feminin Pluriel](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/mfk-feminin-pluriel-edp/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
- [Féminité du Bois Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/feminite-du-bois-edp/): A Serge Lutens classic with a real fan base, and a note list we haven't confirmed yet. Sample it first, since cult scents often come with a learning curve.
- [Fierezza](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-fierezza-extrait/): Xerjoff
- [Fille en Aiguilles Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/fille-en-aiguilles-edp/): Serge Lutens
- [Fleur D'Oranger 27 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/fleur-doranger-27-edp/): Le Labo
- [Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/fucking-fabulous-edp/): Lavender and clary sage, bitter almond and orris, then leather and tonka. The name is doing a lot of the work, so sample it and see if the scent keeps up.
- [Future Memories](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-future-memories-edp/): Byredo
- [Gaiac 10](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/gaiac-10/): Le Labo
- [Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/gentle-fluidity-gold-edp/): A cozy, musky vanilla from Kurkdjian. Comfortable and easy; sample it to see if it's special on you or just nice.
- [Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/gentle-fluidity-silver-edp/): Juniper, nutmeg and coriander over musk, amber woods and vanilla: crisp opening, soft base. Sample it first to see which half of the sentence you are.
- [Geranium Pour Monsieur Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/frederic-malle-geranium-pour-monsieur-edp/): Frederic Malle
- [Godolphin Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/godolphin-edp/): Thyme, saffron and raspberry over leather and blond woods, which is an unusual list. Sample it, because unusual lists are where blind buys go to die.
- [Gold Man Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amouage-gold-man-edp/): Rose, orris and resins over a mossy base, which is a lot of old-world glamour on paper. Sample it, because this is a scent for people who like their drydown with a backstory.
- [Good Girl Gone Bad Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/good-girl-gone-bad-edp/): A full-glam white floral with a name built for TikTok. Pretty, heady, pricey. Sample it first.
- [Greenley Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/greenley-edp/): Parfums de Marly
- [Gris Clair Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/gris-clair-edp/): Serge Lutens
- [Guidance 46](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amouage-guidance-46-extrait/): Amouage
- [Gypsy Water Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/gypsy-water-edp/): Campfire-in-a-pine-forest, but make it Scandinavian. Easy to love; sample it, then compare sizes, because the big bottle is much better value per ml.
- [Hacivat Extrait de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/hacivat-extrait/): Aventus's cooler cousin who moved to Portland. Often recommended to Aventus fans; sample both side by side.
- [Haltane](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/haltane/): A lavender that went to finishing school. Interesting, pricey, not for everyone. Sample it.
- [Herod Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/herod-edp/): Leather-armchair-in-a-Nancy-Meyers-movie energy. A winter scent for most people; sample it before committing to 125 ml of it.
- [High Frequency Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/high-frequency-edp/): Almond and magnolia over vanilla and sandalwood, listed as a floral amber. Sample it, since white florals with almond tend to divide the room.
- [Himalaya](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-himalaya/): A lesser-worn Creed. We haven't confirmed its note list yet; sample before paying Creed prices.
- [Honour Woman Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/honour-woman-edp/): Amouage
- [Hundred Silent Ways](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/nishane-hundred-silent-ways-extrait/): Nishane
- [Inflorescence](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-inflorescence-edp/): BYREDO
- [Interlude 53](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amouage-interlude-53-extrait/): Amouage
- [IOMMI](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-iommi-edp/): Xerjoff
- [Iris 39 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/iris-39-edp/): Le Labo's iris, though we haven't confirmed the note list yet. Sample it, because iris can read powdery, earthy or cold depending on the wearer.
- [Iris Debonair](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-iris-debonair-edp/): Creed
- [Irisss Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/irisss-edp/): Xerjoff
- [Jasmin 17 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/jasmin-17-edp/): Le Labo
- [Jubilation 25 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/jubilation-25-edp/): Amouage's Jubilation 25, with a note list we haven't confirmed yet. Sample it first; a name that happy deserves a verdict from your own skin.
- [Kalan Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/kalan-edp/): Parfums de Marly
- [Kurky](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/kurky-edp/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
- [L'Homme A La Rose](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/mfk-lhomme-a-la-rose-edp/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
- [L'Ombre dans l'Eau Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/l-ombre-dans-l-eau-edp/): Diptyque
- [La Capitale](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-la-capitale-extrait/): Xerjoff
- [La Fille de Berlin Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/la-fille-de-berlin-edp/): Serge Lutens
- [La Tulipe](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/byredo-la-tulipe-edp/): BYREDO
- [Lavender Extreme Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/lavender-extreme-edp/): Tom Ford
- [Line 618](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amouage-line-618-extrait/): Amouage
- [Lipstick Rose Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/frederic-malle-lipstick-rose-edp/): Rose and orange over nutmeg and cinnamon, then sandalwood and vanilla. Sample it; the name promises a look, and the drydown should deliver the rest.
- [Louis XV 1722 Rose](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/xerjoff-louis-xv-1722-rose-extrait/): Xerjoff
- [Love, Don't Be Shy Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/love-dont-be-shy-edp/): A candy-sweet orange blossom with serious fans. Sweetness tolerance varies a lot; sample it.
- [Lumière Noire Pour Homme Eau de Toilette](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/lumiere-noire-pour-homme-edt/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
- [Lustre](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amouage-lustre-extrait/): Amouage
- [Lys 41 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/lys-41-edp/): Le Labo
- [Lys Méditerranée Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/frederic-malle-lys-mediterranee-edp/): Frederic Malle
- [Magnetic Blend 1 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/magnetic-blend-1-edp/): The library has amber and ambergris and nothing else yet, so treat anything beyond that as unconfirmed. Sample it before committing 90 ml to a list this short.
- [Maison Francis Kurkdjian Grand Soir Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/grand-soir-edp/): A Kurkdjian amber with a devoted following. We haven't confirmed its note list or a sample source yet; check back.
- [Maison Margiela Replica Bubble Bath Eau de Toilette](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/maison-margiela-replica-bubble-bath-edt/): Maison Margiela
- [Maison Margiela Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/maison-margiela-replica-lazy-sunday-morning-edt/): Maison Margiela
- [Masculin Pluriel](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/mfk-masculin-pluriel-edt/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
- [Meant To Be Seen](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/nishane-meant-to-be-seen-extrait/): Nishane
- [Meliora Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/meliora-edp/): Blackcurrant and raspberry, rose and jasmine tea, then vanilla and praline. Sample it, because a sweet fruity floral is either your joy or your headache.
- [Memoir Man](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/amouage-memoir-man-edp/): Amouage
- [Millésime Imperial Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/millesime-imperial-edp/): A breezy, polished Creed citrus. Nice in summer, priced for all seasons. Sample it; we haven't found a buyable US bottle yet.
- [Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/mojave-ghost-edp/): Smells-like-expensive-skin territory. Soft and wearable; sample it to check it doesn't vanish on you.
- [Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/frederic-malle-musc-ravageur-edp/): Lavender and orange up top, cinnamon and clove in the heart, then vanilla and amber. Wearers often call it a warm, bedroom-ish scent, so sample it before you make it your office signature.
- [Muscs Koublai Khan Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/muscs-koublai-khan-edp/): Serge Lutens
- [Narcotic Delight](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/initio-narcotic-delight-edp/): Initio Parfums Privés
- [Neroli 36 Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/neroli-36-edp/): Le Labo
- [Noir Épices Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/frederic-malle-noir-epices-edp/): Frederic Malle
- [Noir Extreme Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/noir-extreme-parfum/): Tom Ford
- [Oajan Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/oajan-edp/): Parfums de Marly
- [Opera Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/opera-edp/): Turkish rose and ylang over nutmeg, leather and amber, then patchouli, vanilla and vetiver. Sample it; the name promises theater and the drydown has to earn the curtain call.
- [Oriana Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/oriana-edp/): Citrus and berries up top, then marshmallow, Chantilly cream and musk, so the notes read like a dessert menu. Sample it, since sweet this deliberate is a taste, not a given.
- [Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/creed-original-vetiver-edp/): A crisp, grown-up vetiver. Quietly great, rarely hyped. Sample it if you like fresh-and-woody over sweet.
- [Oud - Extrait de Parfum](https://blindbuyguide.com/scents/mfk-oud-extrait-de-parfum/): Maison Francis Kurkdjian
